Real Paired Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmark Dataset (Rice Bud)

Source: R/data.R
example_rice_bud.Rd

A real, pre-processed paired single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq benchmark dataset of rice bud tissue (Oryza sativa, GEO accession GSE232863). Contains paired empirical reference profiles (200 genes x 100 cells for RNA, 200 peaks x 100 cells for ATAC) across 8 biological cell types and 2 batches, alongside simulated outputs from 6 major single-cell multiomics simulators (scMultiSim, scDesign3, MOSim, scCross, scMoMtF, and Matilda) and observed scalability benchmarks (runtime in seconds and peak RAM in MiB).

Usage

data(example_rice_bud)

Format

A list with 4 elements:

metadata

List containing organism, tissue, GEO accession (GSE232863), data type (Paired), and description.

reference

List containing empirical reference sparse matrices rna (200 x 100) and atac (200 x 100), cell_types (8 cell types), and batches (2 batches).

simulated

Named list of simulated outputs for 6 simulators: scMultiSim, scDesign3, MOSim, scCross, scMoMtF, and Matilda, each with rna and atac count matrices.

scalability_benchmarks

A data.frame with benchmarked Method, Runtime_Seconds, and PeakRAM_MiB.

Source

Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) GSE232863. Preprocessed via standard rice tissue pipeline.

Examples

data(example_rice_bud)
dim(example_rice_bud$reference$rna)
#> [1] 200 100
dim(example_rice_bud$reference$atac)
#> [1] 200 100
names(example_rice_bud$simulated)
#> [1] "scMultiSim" "scDesign3"  "MOSim"      "scCross"    "scMoMtF"   
#> [6] "Matilda"
